_note: Episode 30 (S3E10), story version 2, Kabanata 30: the fifth to seventh depths (Poot: a storm of shouting shadows; Linlang: a hall of whispering shadows, Rico Bulan only as a shadow; Palalo: an ice cavern), the blade of the Trinity in the ice, the marks shining with light (no wound, no gore), the awakening, Usman crossing into the present, Lolo staying below, Teddy sent home by the Daan Pauwi (the diwa only as light, no face), Biringan's gate cut open, Liwayway and Tala, the table in Kawit, the rain rising. Palalo is a pale robed figure, never a demon image. Prompts are setting-first with short character strings; the free endpoint filters brick, violet, museum and gore words. Intro copied from Episode 11. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k97 are montage extras.
